newsitem.title: JAPAN: Holding firms will be good for Japan economy - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Holding firms will be good for Japan economy - EPA.

text.p: Lifting a ban on holding companies will likely have a positive effect on the Japanese economy, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso said on Tuesday.
"Basically, it's a good thing for the economy," he told a news conference.
He added that if holding companies strengthened the international competitiveness of Japanese firms and led to stable employment conditions, they would have a positive effect on the economy.
Aso also said that a lifting of the ban would likely mean that the issue of whether to allow consolidated-basis taxation would have to be addressed.
"Consolidated-basis taxation is not a bad thing either," Aso added.

The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and its allies, the Social Democratic Party and the Sakigake Party, aim to reach a final agreement on lifting the ban on holding companies on Tuesday, an LDP official said on Monday.
